title: Anthropic: Building effective agents (2024)
why: Definitions of workflows and agents, the five workflow patterns, and tool design advice for agents.

title: Anthropic: How we built our multi agent research system (2025)
why: Orchestrator worker architecture with measured gains, token costs and evaluation lessons for multi agent systems.

title: Anthropic: Introducing Contextual Retrieval (2024)
why: Measured retrieval failure reductions from contextual chunks, BM25 and reranking, plus the long context threshold.

title: Yao et al.: ReAct, Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
why: The Thought, Action, Observation loop and its results on HotpotQA, FEVER, ALFWorld and WebShop.

title: Schick et al.: Toolformer
why: Self supervised tool use learned by keeping API calls that reduce the loss on following tokens.

title: Lewis et al.: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Knowledge Intensive NLP Tasks
why: The original RAG model, parametric versus non parametric memory, and the index hot swapping experiment.

title: Karpukhin et al.: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open Domain Question Answering
why: Contrastive bi encoder training with in batch and BM25 hard negatives, with ablation numbers.

title: Thakur et al.: BEIR, a heterogeneous benchmark for zero shot retrieval
why: Zero shot comparison of lexical, dense, late interaction and reranking models, nDCG at 10, latency and index sizes.

title: Khattab and Zaharia: ColBERT
why: Late interaction with summed MaxSim over token embeddings, and its speed and storage trade offs.

title: Cormack, Clarke and Buttcher: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (SIGIR 2009)
why: The RRF formula, the choice of k = 60, and comparisons with Condorcet and CombMNZ.

title: Malkov and Yashunin: Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs
why: HNSW construction, level sampling, neighbour heuristic, parameters, complexity and memory cost.

title: FAISS wiki: Faiss indexes
why: Index types with bytes per vector, IVF and PQ parameters, and which indexes support removal.

title: Okapi BM25 (Wikipedia, citing Robertson and Zaragoza 2009)
why: The BM25 formula, the Lucene IDF variant, and the usual ranges for k1 and b.

title: Liu et al.: Lost in the Middle
why: Position sensitivity of long context models and the limited value of extra retrieved documents.

title: Es et al.: RAGAS, automated evaluation of retrieval augmented generation
why: Definitions of faithfulness, answer relevance and context relevance, and the WikiEval agreement results.

title: Zheng et al.: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
why: Judge modes, measured position, verbosity and self enhancement biases, mitigations, and agreement with humans.

title: Shankar et al.: Who Validates the Validators?
why: Criteria drift and aligning LLM generated evaluators with human grades through coverage and false failure rate.

title: Hamel Husain: Your AI Product Needs Evals (2024)
why: The three levels of evaluation, the Rechat case study, and why generic metrics mislead.

title: Hamel Husain: Using LLM as a judge, critique shadowing (2024)
why: Building a pass or fail judge with a domain expert, data splits, and sample sizes for validation.

title: Eugene Yan: Evaluating the Effectiveness of LLM Evaluators (2024)
why: Survey of LLM evaluator papers, pairwise versus direct scoring, and kappa versus correlation metrics.

title: Jimenez et al.: SWE-bench
why: Construction and test based grading of 2,294 real GitHub issue tasks, with the original baseline results.

title: Yao et al.: tau-bench
why: Tool agent user benchmark with database state grading and the pass hat k reliability metric.

title: Model Context Protocol: architecture overview
why: Hosts, clients and servers, primitives, transports, and the stateless 2026-07-28 protocol version.

title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025)
why: The 2025 list of LLM application risks, from prompt injection to unbounded consumption.

title: Greshake et al.: Indirect Prompt Injection
why: Demonstrations that instructions planted in retrieved content can steal data and control LLM applications.
